an3.114:1.1: Tiṇṇaṃ bhikkhave pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmiṃ. Katamesaṃ tiṇṇaṃ? Tathāgatassa bhikkhave arahato sammāsambuddhassa pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmiṃ. Tathāgatappaveditassa dhammavinayassa desetā puggalo dullabho lokasmiṃ. Kataññū katavedī puggalo dullabho lokasmiṃ. Imesaṃ bhikkhave tiṇṇaṃ pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmin ti. Tayo
